title: Managers: Turn on Safety Notifications
body: If you have Safety Training enabled as part of your Beans Route account, you can receive daily and/or weekly summaries about your drivers’ safety status (e.g., passing or failing) and course(s) to be completed.  To receive these notifications, follow the steps below. From the Dispatch Console: 1.  Click Settings > Preferences > Notifications > Team.   3.  Select which notifications you want to receive and how you want to receive them (e.g. push notification, SMS text, and/or email).  Click "Save."   [The last notification setting “Employee Information Collection Notifications” is not currently active and you should toggle those receipt options to off.]  If you are receiving notifications and do NOT want them, please follow the steps above and toggle off the receive notifications options. Currently the notifications are a global setting which applies to the entire account.  This means we are not able to filter the notifications by warehouse/terminal.
